title: Low-input DNA extractions in 96-well plates
author: Tom Harrop
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.birqkd5w
materials: Set up the reagents from the ZYMO Quick -DNA Magbead Plus Kit
Add the following reagents to the 7-position ReservoirRack

steps.title: Prepare Samples and Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the samples and the necessary lysis buffer for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 100 µL lysis buffer per sample (Zymo lysis solution or Zymo Solid Tissue Buffer II diluted with nuclease-free water from 2x concentrate).

steps.title: Set Up Lysis Plate
steps.instruction: Place samples in a 1000 µL round well deepwell plate and add lysis reagents.

substeps.instruction: Place up to 88 individuals (e.g., M. hyperodae pupa) in the plate.
Add 2 3.2 mm stainless steel ball bearings to each well.
Add 100 µL of lysis buffer with RNase to each well.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue using a plate-compatible tissue homogenizer (e.g., SPEX SamplePrep 2010 Geno/Grinder).

steps.title: Initial Lysis Incubation
steps.instruction: Resuspend the tissue paste and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Seal the plate and mix on the plate shaker to ensure the paste is resuspended.

steps.title: Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K and incubate with intermittent shaking.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL Proteinase K solution (20 mg/mL) and mix on the plate shaker.
Shake the plate for one minute every 30 minutes during incubation.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Transfer Lysate
steps.instruction: Separate the lysate and transfer it to a new plate.

substeps.instruction: Spin the plate for 10 minutes at 1,000 RPM at 15°C.
Transfer 100 µL of lysate to a 0.8 mL deepwell plate.

steps.title: Execute Automated Extraction
steps.instruction: Run the automated extraction protocol on the epMotion system.

substeps.instruction: Run the epMotion protocol '88x Quick-DNA Magbead Plus Low Volume 40_6'.
Ensure level sensing is enabled during the run.
